GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr permitted to ride 0.5kg over allotted weight. From the wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off, kept on one pace # weak run home

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (3L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & tracking up Two Wide @ 500m. Pushed along 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ cutaway & chased steadily without threatening in last 200m. # Sound from easier.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Making the turn near the 1000m was steadied when momentarily tightened for room to the inside. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, held up turn, Straightened Up well off held up, clear 100m, hit line well ate once clear # margin unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. A post-race vet exam revealed a laceration to the off fore pastern. Tnr was told a vet clearance will be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5-6l off, under pressure turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair bustled, settled near last 10+ Lengths off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted behind runners from a wide barrier.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair tailed off and took no part, unsighted in run # took no part
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly & lost ground. Rdr rep the soon after jumping mnt became detached from the field and despite his efforts was unable to regain a position closer to the field. Std when the began to lose ground from the 500m he desisted from riding out any further. A post-race vet exam didn't reveal any abs. Tnr std in his opinion the gelding resented racing in a tongue tie for the first time, & this was the reason the gelding took no competitive part in the race. Tnr was advised the gelding would be required to trial to the satisfaction of stewards prior to racing again. Since passed trial.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok landed box seat 2-3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off, found little and plodded home # weak run home
